title: Reading Images 📷
explanation: **`cv2.imread()`** loads an image from the specified file. Note that OpenCV loads images in **BGR** format by default.

title: Color Conservation 🎨
ques: Convert the loaded image `img` from **BGR to Grayscale**.
explanation: **`cv2.cvtColor()`** converts an image from one color space to another.

title: Edge Detection 📐
ques: Apply **Canny Edge Detection** to the grayscale image `gray`.
explanation: **`cv2.Canny()`** is a popular multi-stage algorithm to detect a wide range of edges in images.
